# Data Loss Prevention
Finds exposed login details, personal data, and classified content in Confluence pages and attachments, then gets it fixed.
# all content stays in-house
jose@sys:~$

Confluence is a shared workspace where teams write pages and upload files. Those pages and files can hold login details, personal data, or content marked confidential, and nothing was checking them. The content also had to stay in-house, so sending it to an outside scanning service wasn't an option.
